summary: Rebecca Bauer-Kahan's December 2023 posts affirmed Israel's right to exist and defend itself while criticizing the Israeli government and calling for minimizing civilian casualties. She authored and voted Aye on AB 715, creating an antisemitism coordinator and classroom-material oversight, invoking her Jewish heritage on the Assembly floor. She proposed AB 2664, a buffer-zone bill criminalizing protest near religious institutions, which critics frame as targeting pro-Palestine protest. The Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club endorsed her; California Jewish Democrats issued Strong Support.
